name: Bun cha Nam Dinh
summary: Skewers of marinated lean pork charred at the edge, with pork belly, egg, thin leaf noodles, and herbs. It is eaten with nước mắm dưa góp, carrot, and green papaya.
origin: Nam Định, on Thế giới tiếp thị, 12 September 2022. It is not a Hanoi address.
taste: Charred pork, white noodles, fresh herbs, and nước mắm dưa góp.
howToEat: From the bowl, with the herbs.
seoTitle: Bun cha Nam Dinh — charred pork and thin noodles
seoDescription: Charred pork skewers, pork belly, egg, and thin noodles with nước mắm dưa góp in Nam Định.
